{"findings":[{"rule_id":"NM-008","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT  :-
1) TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC.
2) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT
AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Note N3 instructs retapping after surface treatment, but the drawing shows no tapped holes—only plain through-holes (D13, D20)—and note N8 specifies an M30 thread without any plating allowance. This is a leftover from another drawing and will confuse the machinist; remove item 2 or replace it with instructions relevant to this part.","recommended_correction":"Delete the retapping instruction from note N3 because no tapped holes exist on this shaft."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N8","page":1,"quote":"M30 x 1.5 x 25 DEEP MAJOR DIA-0.1"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH  :  I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The M30 × 1.5 thread in note N8 carries only a major-diameter offset and no allowance for the zinc plating specified in note N2. Plating buildup will make the thread oversize and prevent assembly with a mating nut; the designer must add a plating-thickness allowance to the thread dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Revise note N8 to include a pre-plate undersize allowance equal to the expected zinc-plating thickness so the finished thread gauges correctly."}]}
